name: EPIC 246822235
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 7.1 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,020 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 0.85 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,817 K at its surface.
